scope: Corruption controls only on the owned disposable full248 fixture; unchanged canonical schema verifier must reject each after the Apple issuer migration is recorded. No production mutation or current-manifest omission is authorized.

cases.name: missing_constraint
cases.sql: ALTER TABLE public.auth_provider_identity DROP CONSTRAINT auth_provider_identity_issuer_check;

cases.name: unvalidated_constraint
cases.sql: ALTER TABLE public.auth_provider_identity DROP CONSTRAINT auth_provider_identity_issuer_check; ALTER TABLE public.auth_provider_identity ADD CONSTRAINT auth_provider_identity_issuer_check CHECK(issuer IN ('https://accounts.google.com','https://appleid.apple.com')) NOT VALID;

cases.name: broadened_issuer
cases.sql: ALTER TABLE public.auth_provider_identity DROP CONSTRAINT auth_provider_identity_issuer_check; ALTER TABLE public.auth_provider_identity ADD CONSTRAINT auth_provider_identity_issuer_check CHECK(issuer IN ('https://accounts.google.com','https://appleid.apple.com','https://attacker.invalid'));

cases.name: rolled_back_google_only
cases.sql: ALTER TABLE public.auth_provider_identity DROP CONSTRAINT auth_provider_identity_issuer_check; ALTER TABLE public.auth_provider_identity ADD CONSTRAINT auth_provider_identity_issuer_check CHECK(issuer='https://accounts.google.com');

cases.name: nullable_issuer
cases.sql: ALTER TABLE public.auth_provider_identity DROP CONSTRAINT auth_provider_identity_pkey; ALTER TABLE public.auth_provider_identity ALTER COLUMN issuer DROP NOT NULL;
cases.setup: PostgreSQL protects NOT NULL while the primary key remains; the transaction drops that fixture key before creating the nullable-column counterexample. All changes roll back.

cases.name: missing_issuer_column
cases.sql: ALTER TABLE public.auth_provider_identity RENAME COLUMN issuer TO missing_issuer;
